newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Daewoo to invest $1 bln in refrigerators.
newsitem.headline: Daewoo to invest $1 bln in refrigerators.

text.p: Daewoo Electronics Co, an affiliate of South Korea's Daewoo Group, said on Thursday it would spend $1 billion by 2002 to become the world's largest refrigerator producer.

A Daewoo Electronics statement said the company's annual refrigerator production capacity would reach seven million -- two million at home and five million abroad. Daewoo plans to build eight plants overseas in addition to the four it now has in Vietnam, Mexico, Spain and India.
Daewoo said it would form task force teams to develop designs, products, sales and service networks which are suitable for each region.
The statement said Daewoo's market share in the world refrigerator market was expected to exceed 12 percent.
